# Douglas Moura

> A software engineer's portfolio sharing practical guides, tutorials, and insights on web development, TypeScript, Node.js, and developer tools.

Douglas Moura writes about modern JavaScript/TypeScript development, Linux system configuration, and software engineering best practices. The site combines technical tutorials with personal reflections on programming and entrepreneurship.

## Key Topics

- TypeScript
- Node.js
- JavaScript
- Web Development
- Linux
- Ubuntu
- Zod
- Git
- npm
- VS Code
- Bash/ZSH
- React
- Fastify
- Software Engineering
- Developer Tools

## Node.js & TypeScript Development

- [Usando TypeScript em projetos Node.js](https://douglasmoura.dev/usando-typescript-em-projetos-node-js): Tutorial on configuring and using TypeScript in Node.js projects
- [Valide suas variáveis de ambiente com Zod](https://douglasmoura.dev/valide-suas-variaveis-de-ambiente-com-zod): Guide to validating environment variables using Zod in TypeScript and Node.js
- [Devo commitar o node_modules no git?](https://douglasmoura.dev/devo-commitar-o-node-modules-no-git): Best practices guide on managing node_modules in Git repositories

## Developer Workflow & Tools

- [Aliases do Git que uso diariamente](https://douglasmoura.dev/aliases-do-git-que-uso-diariamente): Tips and tricks for Git aliases to improve terminal productivity in daily workflow
- [Instalando o tema Dracula no Gnome Console](https://douglasmoura.dev/instalando-o-tema-dracula-no-gnome-console): Tutorial for installing Dracula theme in Gnome Console on Linux systems
- [Corrigindo a configuração do teclado americano no Ubuntu](https://douglasmoura.dev/corrigindo-a-configuracao-do-teclado-americano-no-ubuntu-24-04): Guide to fixing American keyboard configuration issues on Ubuntu 24.04
- [Instalando o WhatsApp no Linux](https://douglasmoura.dev/instalando-o-whats-app-no-linux): How-to guide for installing WhatsApp on Linux using Chrome web app

## Blog & Insights

- [Como foi a minha experiência no Elixir Days 2024](https://douglasmoura.dev/como-foi-a-minha-experiencia-no-elixir-days-2024): Conference experience report from Elixir Days 2024 with insights on Elixir programming
- [Como ficar rico, segundo Naval](https://douglasmoura.dev/como-ficar-rico-segundo-naval): Article discussing Naval Ravikant's wealth creation principles and entrepreneurship
- [O dia em que quase fui envolvido em um crime eleitoral](https://douglasmoura.dev/o-dia-em-que-quase-fui-envolvido-em-um-crime-eleitoral): Personal story about identity confusion and electoral fraud investigation in Brazil
